slot_scores.name: unclear_overtime_minimization_goal
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked how to handle the separate overtime-minimization objective or the trade-off between maximizing profit and minimizing overtime. It treated overtime only as a cost deducted from profit.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Overtime minimization can be handled solely by deducting overtime cost from profit, rather than as a separate objective or multi-objective trade-off.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent did not ask how to reconcile the stated profit-maximization and overtime-minimization goals; it silently converted overtime into a cost term in the profit objective.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL without resolving the P0 hidden slot about how to handle the separate overtime-minimization objective.

summary: The agent clarified several useful modeling details, but it missed the core P0 ambiguity around the dual objectives and silently assumed overtime minimization could be folded into the profit objective.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
